failure_summary.description: Returned multiple alternative labels for a singular role instead of the single answer expected.
Repeated the named example rather than answering the category requested by the clue.

patch.reasoning: The existing target-selection rules already cover answering a clue’s requested category rather than repeating its example, so that failure does not warrant a duplicate rule. Add a focused instruction for singular clues where context supplies alternative labels: choose the one most directly supported by the clue instead of returning a disjunction.

edits.content: When a clue requests one singular role or entity but context offers alternative labels, choose the single label most directly defined by the clue; do not return an “or” list unless alternatives are requested.
